items.name: Ranger's Oath-Ring
items.lore: The ring a Friend of the Rangers is given: plain iron, an arrow scratched inside.

items.name: Collory-Road Belt
items.lore: A ranger's belt, with loops for a dozen arrows and one flask.

items.name: Druim Cain Torc
items.lore: Bronze, with the keep's gate worked into the clasp.

items.name: Waywatcher's Bracer
items.lore: Worn by the rangers who watch the Collory road at night.

items.name: Mantle of the Collory Road
items.lore: Grey-green, with an arrow on the shoulder. Only the Wardens of the Collory Road wear it.

items.name: Hill-Friend's Charm
items.lore: A sprig of rowan and a scarlet thread. Midir's people know it.

items.name: Etain's Ribbon Belt
items.lore: A scarlet ribbon woven into green linen, the way they wear it in Caille.

items.name: Guest-Gift Torc
items.lore: A guest-gift from under the hill. Gold, warm, and humming faintly with music.

items.name: Moonlit Bracer
items.lore: Silver from Moon Lake's shore. It shines a little in the dark.

items.name: Mantle of Bri Leith
items.lore: Green and gold, embroidered with scarlet wings. Only the Beloved of Bri Leith wear it.
